transcript: Patient comes with right flank pain and burning micturition since two days. Ultrasound shows 5 mm lower ureteric calculus, no hydronephrosis. Advise urine culture and serum creatinine. Prescribe tablet Tamsulosin 0.4 mg once daily at bedtime after food for two weeks, tablet Deflazacort 6 mg twice daily after food for five days, syrup Potassium Magnesium Citrate 15 ml in a glass of water three times daily after food for two weeks, and tablet Paracetamol 650 mg as needed for pain. Ask patient to drink 3 liters of water daily and review after two weeks with ultrasound report.
